name: constellation-hub
description: Feature nodes brighten in narration order as real-length SVG connectors draw outward from a fixed central hub, then settle into one lockup.

vars.description: Text displayed inside the fixed central hub.
Comma-separated feature labels introduced in narration order.
Comma-separated seconds (from mount start) for each node reveal. Empty keeps the authored even spread.
Highlight color used by the hub, connectors, and active nodes.
Optional departure. Default none: the lockup holds until the frame cuts.
